mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower financing costs for corporate expansion and reduced risk premiums.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals labor market weakness that triggers central bank accommodative policy responses, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as risk assets gain relative attractiveness.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate contracting consumer demand, triggering recession risk aversion that produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 1.5% monthly) signals robust supply expansion that boosts corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during economic expansion cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 1.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1600 thousand units signals residential sector contraction that precedes consumer spending slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as recession risks materialize.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1600, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year periods.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 5.0% indicates restrictive monetary policy that suppresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as credit conditions tighten.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals labor market strength that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) indicates robust supply-side expansion that accelerates corporate profit growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both INDPRO and GDPC1 grow, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 2-year periods.
